alkylation_concentration.evidence: 100μg of homogenised extract (fECM or tECM protein amount determined by Direct Detect method) was diluted to either 130μL (purified proteins) or 500μL (fECM and tECM) in 5% SDS, 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB), pH 7.5, prior to reduction with 5mM Dithiothreitol (DTT) and alkylation with 15mM Iodoacetamide (IAM).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were then concentrated by an S-trap column (ProtiFi LLC, Fairport, NY, USA) which was washed with binding buffer before addition of 20μL trypsin at ration of 1:10 trpsin:sample in 50mM TEAB.
